scripts.build: pnpm --filter @boxvault/qr build && tsc -b && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs && vite build && vite build --ssr src/seo/prerender.tsx --mode prerender --outDir .prerender && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:connected: pnpm --filter @boxvault/qr build && tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.connected.config.ts
scripts.build:aws: pnpm --filter @boxvault/qr build && tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.aws.config.ts --mode aws && node scripts/audit-aws-build.mjs
